evaluator.name: livecodebench-exact-literal-v1
evaluator.official_evaluator_note: The upstream evaluator calls Python eval on extracted model text. The CEG adapter freezes a narrower literal-only output grammar and uses ast.literal_eval/json.loads; there is no execution of generated code. It is an exact typed-value evaluator for the frozen grammar, not a claim of leaderboard-protocol identity.
